title: Start here still demotes rows for hosts their buildable names only as spent or alternative sources
problem: refused_rows demotes a flagship row when any host in its hosts: list or its buildable prose is refused. photo-editing's buildable names raw.pixls.us only as a source whose files are 'all read', while its open work runs on github.com, yet the row is moved behind every reachable one whenever raw.pixls.us refuses. Separately, allocate.py's _HOST_RE knows no .co, .ai or .ru TLD, so prose naming huggingface.co is never probed unless hosts: lists it.
